objective: Implement deterministic reference-only partial-close planning bound to an exact canonical P21-A position state and its current P21-B protection plan, preserving a positive remainder and requiring protection rebind after the reduction fill without broker access, OMS mutation or Live execution authority.
scope: Bind every partial-close request to exact P21-A position_record_id and position_id
Require OPEN or PARTIALLY_CLOSED canonical position with positive open quantity
Require a current P21-B protection plan bound to the same exact canonical position record
Accept caller-supplied close quantity and reason code without selecting universal staged-exit percentages
Compute a deterministic positive remaining quantity
Require P21-B protection to be rebound after the reduction fill creates a new canonical P21-A record
Produce deterministic content-addressed reference partial-close plans
Keep plans non-executable and generate byte-identical P21-C evidence
out_of_scope: Choosing strategy-specific close fractions, tranche counts or exit timing
Direct mutation of P21-A canonical position state
Broker/exchange order placement, cancellation or modification
tests: OPEN and PARTIALLY_CLOSED positions can produce a strictly partial reduction plan
Zero, full-close and over-close quantities fail closed
Closed or zero-exposure positions fail closed
Mismatched or stale P21-B protection plan fails closed
Caller-supplied reason code must be from governed taxonomy
Remaining quantity is positive and deterministic
Plan requires P21-B rebind after reduction fill
No broker query, OMS mutation or external-order authority is emitted
P21-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P21-C package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P21-A and P21-B remain canonical complete and P21-D remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict partial quantity, exact position lineage and current protection binding tests pass
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
